stages.headline: A cylinder's volume is V = πR²h (base area times height).
stages.headlineEnglish: A cylinder's volume is V = πR²h (base area times height).

stages.headline: A cone's volume is one third of the cylinder with the same base and height: V = ⅓ πR²h.
